title: Thimsy ES-DE/nano/emulators.json
description: Android's per-game emulator choices that ES-DE has no label for (esdeStoreSaveGameEmu, NanoEsdeStore.cpp). Android-owned; written in place, so unknown top-level keys and other games' items survive, and the re-picked game's item is rebuilt as {game, label, am}. The 'key' field is this contract's addition (written by Android from the compatibility floor on). Linux reads this file and never writes it (proposed, W7-INTEROP; Linux's own per-game choices are in systems.linux.json). Unknown fields are allowed here because the file is already in the field. Only the draft-07 keywords devicejson.py validates are used.

version.description: Android forces it to 1 on every write; never relied on.

game.description: ES-DE folder, '/', the path relative to it, case kept, no './'.

label.description: Nano's display label of the emulator.

am.description: Android am start arguments; Android loads an item only when it matches its catalogue.

key.description: The portable key of the same choice that 'am' describes.
